reviews.text:
My 5 month puppy Risotto loves it here! Both Matt and Ronnie who pick her up are adored by her, and I know look after her well.

I’m really pleased with the service the London Dog Club provides and the love and care they give my nervous pup!
My dog loves London Dog Club, especially Kitti and is always very excited when she gets collected. Booking is very easy and convenient too .

London dog club has provided a great team of staff for collection, drop off and care of our dog since we’ve been with them. Most recently, we have had the pleasure of Matt providing care and support for our dog Freddy. He’s been incredible at collection, drop off and daily care and observation of Freddy, always insuring he is taken care of, happy and comfortable. To see how excited Freddy is to see him every week is a true testament to how great he has been!
Our cavapoo Freddy absolutely loves London Dog Club! Matt is brilliant, always friendly, reliable and great with Freddy. I always know he’s in good hands. Couldn’t recommend Matt and the team enough!

I’ve had a wonderful experience with London Dog Club. My dog Reuben can be reactive on the leash and I was worried about how he’d do at daycare. Reuben has loved his time and especially his driver Ronnie. London Dog Club is also so convenient because they pick up your dog and drop them off. Ronnie is consistently on time. I would definitely reccomend.

Have been using London Dog Club for a while now - Emmie generally collects our dog Zola and sends us updates and pictures - Zola clearly loves her.  Emmie is excellent at keeping us informed, always goes the extra mile - totally trust her with Zola and would highly recommend London Dog Club - mainly because Emmie is so excellent.

Cannot recommend London Dog Club enough. They are always very accommodating and provide amazing care for all dogs and a big reason for that is Kitti, one of their members, particularly in regards to my dog Bueno. Bueno absolutely adores her. The second he spots her his tail start wagging and he’s straining to get to her. Kitti is genuinely one of the warmest, most caring people you could hope to have looking after your dog. Her love for animals is obvious in everything she does the way she treats Bueno like he’s her own, and I have complete peace of mind knowing he’s in her hands. You can see how much she adores the dogs, and that care shows in how well looked after they always are and in the updates we all receive with our pups. She’s also brilliantly organised and communicative. Kitti always lets me know in advance exactly what time she’ll be picking Bueno up the next day, which takes all the stress and guesswork out of the arrangement. Kitti is an absolute star, by far Bueno’s favourite member and London Dog Club is lucky to have her. If you’re looking for a day care that treats your dog like family, this is the place.

Angus loves his days at daycare with London dog club!
As soon as he sees Matt in the doggy bus, he is excited to get in the bus and on his way.
It’s adorable to see. He comes back worn out with all the play and ready for snuggles 🐾💕.

We've been so happy with this dog day care, and so has our dog, Luna! She absolutely loves going and always comes home happy, relaxed, and well looked after. The team clearly cares so much about the dogs, and it really shows. A special thank you to her driver, Matt, who is so caring, friendly, and lovely with Luna. It's such a comfort knowing she's in such kind and capable hands.
I am very happy with the service that London Dog club provides. My dog gets so excited when I tell her Paige is coming to pick her up! She is so kind and gentle with Bunty.

We have been so, so impressed with London Dog Club. Cara has been so wonderful with ensuring that our dog has settled in and that she is well looked after. She has taken the time to ensure that our dog does not overexert herself (following an operation a few months ago) which we are really appreciative of and have found no other day care who would do the same. Everyone on the team is friendly and caring; we are so happy that we have found London Dog Club for our fur-baby.

Matt , the driver,  is so lovely with our dog and we feel so happy knowing he is taking good care of her.

My dog has been coming here since he was a puppy. Every time we wake him up to tell him that Kitti is coming he gets so excited and waits by the door. He’s always so excited to see her!! Her and the team are great with updates, either Kitti sending me pictures/videos in the day or they also save down photos everyday so I can see him playing with his doggy friends. He always comes home so tired from his fun day out! Having him collected and dropped off everyday is such an amazing option where I work full time. 10/10 recommend Kitti & London Dog Club. They’re amazing!

What amazing service. My cockapoo adores going. I suspect she wishes she could go every day. They pick up a happy dog and bring back a happy tired dog. Perfect. The pick up and drop off are fabulous with a breakdown of what my gorgeous pooch has been up to and I feel they really care. A great facility and a wonderful safe service. Thank you.
My two doggies love their days at London Dog Club and Emmie is always particularly helpful and has the dogs best interests at heart 💓 …

I wish I could give more than 5 stars, as I cannot say enough positive things about London Dog Club. Everybody on the team  is so kind and caring, to both me and my dog, and despite being quite a popular place their attention to detail and individual care for my dog is unmatched and there’s no care services I trust more than them. Communication, care and accommodation from the staff at London dog club is top notch. So grateful for London Dog Club and everybody who is apart of it, couldn’t recommend enough for a place to send your dog in London for a caring and enriching environment for your dog , and stress and worry free experience for you!

My dog has been at London Dog Club since he was a puppy. He is looked after incredibly well by Paige who he loves, and the wider team are all fantastic & very professional. You can tell how much loves it by how excited he is when he's picked up every day- the absolute highlight of the week for him. Highly recommend to anyone needing a place they can trust and give their dog the best time.

Dasher has blossomed after going to The London Dog Club. Kitti, who collects her, is a god send and Dasher gets very excited. Kitti is an excellent ambassador for the company and is essential for Dasher's development.

I cant speak highly enough of the London Dog Club. All the staff are so polite and professional. Joey looks out the window for Emmie & is so happy to see her when she picks her up for day care. Emmie sends lovely photos & videos of her having a whale of a time playing with other dogs. A big thank you to all the team at the London Dog Club!

I cannot recommend London Dog Club enough! Run by great people who truly love and care about dogs. My dog Hercules had such a great time and was well looked after. It's tough leaving your dog whether it's just for the day, or for an extended period, but I felt so much better and reassured knowing he was in comfortable and safe hands. He absolutely loves his time there 💙

Hercules was happy and comfortable right from the off with James, the driver, who was a calming presence with him and the other dogs. The whole team is great with communication, with pick up and drop off times noted, and at the end of the day you are able to access a photo album to see how your dog got on. Thank you LDC! 🌟

Our dog Kona has been going to London Dog Club since she was a puppy, and we truly credit them for how comfortable she is around other dogs. She’s really come out of her shell and now absolutely loves being around them. The service is incredibly convenient, and we always know she’s having an amazing time running around all day ❤️

Snickers has been going to LDC for years and we trust them completely. He knows the van by its noise and nearly breaks his back by wagging his tail so hard when he hears it. Emmie picks him up with the uttermost care, always very gentle and loving. I already caught her giving him kisses while putting him in the van. The super high quality photos we receive are also a nice treat!

LDC is amazing - the best people and service. Always keeping us posted on collection and drop off times. Consistent updates with photos, videos, and with a personalised touch via text. Emmie is a gem of a carer at LDC - she is the best with our pup, Poppy. We couldn't be happier with her and how she treats our doggo. We trust her completely; always met with a kind greeting and friendly service. Thank you, Emmie and LDC!

Emmie from London Dog Club is absolutely incredible with our very over the top, Jack Russell, Poppy. On doggy daycare, Poppy waits for Emmie from 6am for her 9am pickup with pure excitement for the day. Her days are filled with loads of play time that tires her out for the 2 days which certainly helps when WFH. It’s an absolute treat being a part of the London Dog Club and I can guarantee Poppy agrees!

We’ve been sending our young pup Maple to LDC for a few months now and she has always enjoyed her time there. We love the extra care the team takes to make Maple’s time at daycare so much fun. Special thanks to Emmie and Kitti for being the best carers!!

Hello Sophie,

Thank you so much for your review!

We're very happy to hear that you are pleased with our Daycare Services. Our team works very hard to ensure that Coco has the best time with us and they love reading reviews like this! We look forward to seeing Coco with us again soon.

With love, London Dog Club! 💙

My only critique is that I’m slightly worried that my dogs now prefer Emmie and Jasper from London Dog Club more than me. When I saw “Jasper” or “Emmie” at my house they line up and sit by the door, tails wagging. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my dogs, it makes me so content knowing how happy they are with you both.

London dog Club are like a second family to my dog Hugo. I have been sending him there for the last 5 years I fully trust them and they have trained him in such ways that he grew into well behaved mannered dog. He gets so excited when he gets picked up particularly if it’s Emmie who he is in love with and she knows how to look after him and train him , she is very good with dogs and I trust her 100% with Hugo, she even looks after him when I’m away and it really puts my mind at ease when he is with her, it’s adorable how much he gets excited when he sees Emmie. After a day at the club he comes back so tired from playing all day that gets it out of his system. I couldn’t recommend them enough. Dogs learn from each other at the end of the day so sending your dog for at least once a week to socialise with others is very important. The team does make sure that every dog feels special and well looked after and they make sure they all come home safe and happy. Thank you to London Dog Club I couldn’t imagine Hugo life without it.
We love London Dog Club! Matt is great and so reliable. Our dog Ness absolutely loves him and gets so excited when he arrives to pick her up!

London dog club has been an absolute dream from the beginning. Cam who is Stella’s driver picks her up in the morning with the biggest smile, he always gives her a big hug & genuinely loves seeing her. Cam makes getting up at 6:30 for pick up more ok 😂
Once she gets there I feel like I’m right there with her as Emmie is SO on it with taking videos and pictures of Stella. All my friends and family now follow LDC instagram because of how cute all the posts are, not just of Stella! I honestly couldn’t recommend them enough.

Thank you London Dog Club for helping us spoil our dogs rotten. Joke aside, we are very happy with the service. Entire team have been attentive and professional. Special thanks to Matt who always wears a smile and is well liked and trusted by the family.
The club is fantastic with our dog. Matt picks him promptly and our dog always loves seeing him in the morning - recommend to anyone looking for a place to send their beloved pup to for the day!

Biscuit and Evie have come home every day with their tails wagging and ready to nap after a very full day at daycare! They are always so happy and completely tired out which is fantastic! Hannah picks them up and drops them off and she is absolutely lovely and so easy to communicate with, and she is so kind with my doggies. Thank you so much! I couldn’t be happier 😊

Our dog, Indy, has been going to London Dog Club for a couple of years & we could not live without them! The team are reliable, trustworthy & seem to really care about each dog. Communication is great & pick up/drop off arrangement always works perfectly. We love the daily photo library too! Every member of staff is fantastic but Cam and Georgia in particular truly go above and beyond. I think Indy loves Cam more than he loves us! We’ve also used their boarding services, which have been a lifesaver for last minute work trips. Would 100% recommend!

Matt is an incredible dog handler. It’s Skip’s favorite day of the week; he bolts out of the house without a second glance! Matt is also exceptionally reliable, always right on time, and a fantastic representative of the company.

Twiggy loves going to daycare! Emmie picks her up and drops her off with the doggy bus and on the few occasions I'm home you can tell how much Twiggy trusts her. Emmie sends me photos during the day and keeps me updated with when Twiggy will come home. She has also been really helpful in being flexible with pick up/drop off instructions. London Dog Club has become a staple in Twiggy's care plan and we are so pleased with it.

The apple of our eye Ziggy has been going to London Dog Club since he was a puppy - he’s been going for 5 years and he always looks forward to it. He has had a few favourite carers since the beginning  including Phil, Ryan, Emily who have all moved on but thankfully, his new love is Kitty whom he adores! She’s brilliant with hin. It’s reassuring to know he is loved and looked after at daycare!
My dogs adore Matt, and couldn’t be happier to see him when he comes to collect them!

We have been using London Dog Club for the past six months for pick up, drop off and day care for our 2 small dogs. I am pleased to recommend them with special mention to Kitti, who provides us an accurate ETA every evening for the following morning and clearly cares deeply for our dogs and I’m sure for all the others. Thanks to the whole team and we look forward to happy puppies and great communication continuing

Matt has been amazing with Felix! My dog absolutely adores him, he cries with excitement when he sees Matt and never looks back on the way to the van. It’s such a relief knowing Felix is so well looked after, especially when we’re away. Thank you, Matt! Thank you London Dog Club for such reliable and excellent service!
My dog goes here and is always extremely excited when Kitti comes to pick her up every morning!🐾 …

Luna has been going to London Dog Club since she was a puppy, and she absolutely loves it! Every morning when Matt arrives to pick her up, she gets so excited, barks and jumps around and can hear him even before he rings the bell — she clearly adores him. One of her favourite things is sitting up front with him in the van, which just shows how much trust and comfort she feels with him. Matt and the team are fantastic, reliable, and genuinely care about the dogs. We’re so grateful to LDC and especially Matt. Highly recommend!
They are the best, Ringo has been going there for some years, he totally love it and comes back knackered and happy, I can tell they are kind and loving with him.

can’t recommend London Dog Club highly enough! My French Bulldog absolutely loved it there from day one, and it’s become his favourite place to visit. But what truly sets them apart is how incredible Cara and the team have been with my super nervous Cocker Spaniel.

He’s always been shy and unsure in new environments, but thanks to Cara’s gentle, patient approach and the warm, welcoming atmosphere she’s helped create, he’s now walking in with a wagging tail and so much more confidence. It means the world to see him feel safe and happy.

Huge thanks to Cara and everyone at London Dog Club for the love and care you’ve shown both of my dogs — we’re so grateful!

The team are all great, they pick up when they say they will and do their best to be responsive to requests. Our dogs particularly love Ryan K (jimmy is our youngest and he is beside himself when he sees Ryan)

Today’s was the last day of Philippe at London Dogs club where he has been for the last 3 years, he will miss his daycare and fun place where he has so many friends tabs love of care and fun… special shout out to Kiti driver who has been so lovely to its Philippe specially when he is nervous and stressed she was so calm and knows him and treated him with care and love … Thank you for these years of care with my little pup… he will miss u

Had a truly top tier experience for my dog’s first day at daycare. James, his driver, was very professional and accommodating for my nervous terrier. At the end of the day, the Daycare Manager Cara called me with a really detailed summary of Oskar’s experience. Overall, I felt like we were both well taken care of! :)

I highly recommend London Dog Club - I have been sending Phoenix there for almost 2 years and I love the high level of service, care and professionalism they provide. Phoenix is well looked after and he loves spending the day at London Dog Club. He is also absolutely in love with all the staff (very friendly and trustworthy) especially Ryan to name a few ❤️ and the owners especially Lewis 🤍

My Labrador has been going to the LDC once a week for daycare since she was a tiny puppy and she absolutely loves it! The LDC team takes care of her with such care and love, always tailored to her personality, needs and age. Special thank you to Emmie who picks her up and drops her off every time and sends me tons of pics and updates during the day while my pup is with her, and also thank you to daycare manager Cara who is always available to advise on my questions!

We are so happy we found London Dog Club! Our dog Naomi recently had spinal surgery and can’t play actively with other dogs. The team at LDC has been amazing — they keep a close eye on her, offer her lots of mental activities, gentle care, and plenty of cuddles. The team has been amazing from day one. Manager Cara treats every dog like her own, and communication has been open, clear, and caring from the start.

Naomi was nervous about getting into the van at first, but her carer and driver Jasper has built such a strong bond with her that now she’s excited to see him every morning. He’s always so careful helping her in and out, making sure she’s safe and comfortable.

If you have a dog with special needs (or even if you don't!), I cannot recommend London Dog Club enough. Lovely, professional, caring people — truly the best!

Love London dog club, and so does Jasper. He hears the van before I do and goes mental. This is clever because the van is electric. He loves all the boys there but is particularly fond of Matt for some reason. Thank you Matt and thank you, LDC.
The team have been great and flexible looking after my wee jack Russell. Huge thank you to Sam and Kitti for becoming his best mates!

KITTI and the team at LDC have been amazing, I can’t fault them and my dog absolutely loves it there - I’ve used the daycare and kennel services on regular occasions and my dog always comes back happy, he particularly likes KITTI and he gets super excited when she comes to collect him! Thank you all for your help.

Sam had been an absolute star looking after my little Cavapoo. Cooper gets really excited when he comes to the door, always a sign of love ❤️ He was great with communication and I would definitely recommend him.
London dog club is a great place. My Finn loved going there every morning. Sam & Cam has been picking him up. They are all so friendly. 5/5
Curtis and Archie absolutely loved daycare at LDC. Special thanks to Sam for making sure they arrived and were returned safely whenever they went to LDC!

My dog Bonnie has been going to daycare at LDC for 3 years now and she has a great time. She loves seeing Jasper in the morning, and he always lets us know when she will be picked up and that she is home. Then she gets to spend her whole day getting attention from Paige who she adores! The daily photos are great, and she even gets a little birthday party each year.

Our dog loves her days at school! Sam is our main point of contact - he is very responsible and always lets us know the plan but mostly he is fabulous with our rescue pup who can be nervous at times. We feel very comfortable knowing she’s in good hands with him, plus she adores him!

Our staffie Alfie is always so excited to see his driver and carer Matt when he gets picked up for daycare - it’s the highlight of his week! Matt has clearly built a great bond with him which is so nice to see, and you can tell that he really cares about all the dogs he looks after. He’s very friendly and we trusted him with Alfie from the off. Pick-up and drop-off are always seamless, and Matt’s so helpful with any questions – he even went out of his way to rummage about in the mud for Alfie’s lost name tag, which was incredibly kind! Thank you Matt and London Dog Club for taking such great care of Alfie - we would 100% recommend sending your pup here.

Amazing and friendly service, Matt’s always full
of high spirits and willing to chat. Kaiser is so happy, he literally dives for the door when Matt knocks. Would go anywhere else x

Our 3 year old cocker spaniel, Luna, absolutely loves her time at London Dog Club. Cam picks her up most of the time and is amazing! It’s the highlight of Luna’s week when she sees him at the door. She’s always been really well taken care of; always returned clean which we know would be a particular challenge with our messy girl. Highly recommend to anyone considering daycare for their pup!

Sam, at London Dog Club, collects and brings back our dog twice a week. He is on time and I really appreciate that he let's me know if there are any delays for collection. Sam has a lovely manner with our dog and I completely trust the wellbeing of our dog to Sam. I appreciate the care that Sam provides - thank you!

Thank you so much London Dog Club

Rocco is now completely back to routine after moving home.
He is so happy to go to ‘school’ and today he was wagging his tail waiting for Dan to pick him up.
You all staff do a great job, despite the weather being so not nice.

Thank you for your help.

I was worried to get a dog due to my working schedule, but I am so glad that I found someone who can look after Rocco when I have to work and where Rocco is 😃 happy

Matt is the carer/handler who picks up Rocco to go to School.
It is nice to have a consistent person designated to the pick up. This builds trust and serenity that silly Rocco is well looked after.

The pick up is always on time and Rocco can spot the van approaching so he is more than ready to go to school.

Monica

We have used the London Dog Club since Nala was a puppy! She loves it. She’s so excited to see Kitty when she arrives in the morning. Kitty is punctual and professional and obviously loves dogs. It’s amazing daycare to help with socialisation, a change of scene and she returns exhausted. It’s a well run service and dogs are well taken care of.

The London Dog Club is absolutely fantastic! The staff are warm, attentive, and clearly love every pup that joins the club. My dog comes home happy, tired, and well-socialized after every visit—and always clean (even on a rainy day). The facility is safe, and filled with fun, enriching activities. My doggie can even jump over little bars now and love that I get photo updates. I trust the London Dog Club completely and wouldn’t take my fur baby anywhere else. Thank you so much to the Club!
I have been a client for 5 years. Norman loves going and Ryan is a sweetheart. Norman sits on the front door mat when I tell him Ryan is coming to get him. Would highly recommend.

Superb team and service. From the start, good communication and our pup had a great time as evidenced by coming home happy and tired each trip. The photos they send are a real bonus as well. Never had any problems with the pick up and drop off, kept well informed of timings throughout. Highly recommended.

Bon Bon and Chom Chom, my two senior corgis, recently joined London Dog Club’s daycare, and I couldn’t be happier. Huge thanks to the field manager Cara, our driver Ryan, and the brilliant team—Kai, Cam, and everyone else - who took such great care of them. 🎉

They had an absolute blast running around, making new friends, and getting plenty of love and attention. It’s clear the team truly love what they do, and it gave me real peace of mind knowing my two were in such good hands.

Finding a daycare that blends professionalism with genuine care isn’t easy, but London Dog Club does it effortlessly. Bon Bon and Chom Chom came home happy, relaxed, and wonderfully tired - a clear sign of a day well spent! We’ll definitely be back! 💙

My partner and I have been sending our puppy Roo to London Dog Club for almost 3 months now and both he and ourselves have had such a wonderful experience. The team have been so communicative and have taken such good care of our little Roo - he has a soft spot for Sam and Cara in particular who keep him very safe, entertained and happy during his daycare. Both Sam and Cara have been incredibly helpful and accommodating and we’ve especially enjoyed seeing the photos of Roo that they send us from his fun-filled days with them! LDC has definitely helped Roo grow in confidence around other dogs - he starts his daycare mornings buzzing with excitement when Sam arrives to pick him up, and when he’s dropped back home we have a calm, sleepy puppy who’s tired out from all the fun!

We have been using LDC for over 2 and half years and have found them professional, warm and most importantly dog lovers - we and Loki love all the team members, special shout outs to Lewis, Kaii, Cara, Sam and especially to Kitti who shows Loki lots of love and patience when he’s reluctant to leave his bed for early morning starts, the patience and cuddles Kitti has for Loki knows no bounds and he’s soon on his way - thank you to all of the LDC team for taking such great care of Loki

My two dogs have been going to London Dog Club for many years and are always very excited to see Ryan when he comes to pick them up. They come home tired and happy. Ryan always gives us an update and he and the rest of the team seem genuinely fond of them. We are very happy to send them to London Dog Club!

We've been using London Dog Club for a few years and have always been very impressed with their service. The team are always polite and friendly. They really care about the dogs and look to make their days as fun as possible. Bertie is always very excited to see his good friend Sam with special mention to Cam and Matt. It's always reassuring to know he is being very well looked after.

Amazing daycare for my golden retriever, she absolutely loves it. London dog club are so flexible and have recommended to a number of friends. Really trust them with my dog and she always comes back tired which is great!

We've been using this doggy daycare since Fleur was a puppy (almost 3 years). The level of care and service is exceptional. Super easy to book the days you want online and the staff really care about the pups. In winter, Fleur always has a …

When we moved from the US I was a bit wary of finding a daycare as Enzo has separation anxiety and prefers human interaction over other dogs. From the start, Kaii and the whole team were welcoming, understanding of the situation, and …

Emmie is a wonderful girl! The first time I sent Skye off to London Dog Club, Emmie was messaging me the night before reassuring me that everything is fine and that she will take extra care of Skye! Every time she collects my girl Skye is so happy to see her! Appreciate the messages and caring 🙏🏻thank you!! …

We’ve been using London Dog Club for years now with our cocker spaniel and German Shepherd and couldn’t recommend them enough. The early pick up times are different to many other daycares out there - which is great for working doggy …

Ordered a few treats for the dog for christmas, what turned up was so unexpected, cant thank Lewis & the team enough😊 Going to have one very happy puppy on Christmas Day! Shipping was also so quick, I cant recommend these guys enough! Thank you once again! …

I’ve been using the services of London Dog Club for a while now, and I can’t speak highly enough of their exceptional daycare service—especially with their pickup and drop-off feature! For anyone juggling a busy schedule, this service is an …

We started to use London Dog Club as we saw one of their vans parked at the top of our road, across from Spencer park and it has been our best decision. Our Labrador Axel is quite an anxious boy so it really helped him to socialise and it’s …
